title: Biomimetic liposomal co-delivery of quercetin and carnosine for enhanced transdermal penetration and NRF2/HES1-mediated antioxidant photoprotection.
authors: Xia, Xiuyuan; Zhang, Zhenghan; Wang, Yizhen; Chen, Chen; Wang, Yaqi; Luo, Yanting; Gao, Ying; Hong, Weiyong; Ren, Chuanpeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究脂质体共递送槲皮素和肌肽的透皮抗氧化光保护作用，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Quercetin and carnosine, natural antioxidants with anti-aging and photoprotective potential, face therapeutic limitations due to poor skin permeability. We engineered EV-QuerCar, a liposomal-based nanoparticles (LPNs) system co-encapsulating both compounds, to enhance transdermal delivery and evaluate its structural and functional efficacy. EV-QuerCar was prepared biomimetically using thermophilic bacterial lipids via ultracentrifugation, thin-film hydration, and high-pressure homogenization. Physicochemical properties, transdermal penetration, cellular uptake, and cytotoxicity were tested in vitro. Molecular docking and qPCR assessed pathway targeting. EV-QuerCar exhibited uniform size (94.70 +/- 0.71 nm), high encapsulation efficiency (90.07%), sustained release, and 3.21-fold enhanced transdermal absorption compared to free compounds. Cellular uptake in fibroblasts increased time-dependently (up to 5.48-fold at 4 h). Molecular docking and qPCR confirmed interactions with NRF2 and HES1 targets, significantly upregulating their mRNA levels (2.29- and 3.35-fold, respectively) in UV-exposed human fibroblasts. EV-QuerCar improves skin permeability and antioxidant efficacy, highlighting its cosmeceutical promise.
abstract_zh: 槲皮素和肌肽作为具有抗衰老和光保护潜力的天然抗氧化剂，因皮肤渗透性差而面临治疗局限性。我们设计了EV-QuerCar，一种共包封这两种化合物的脂质体基纳米颗粒（LPNs）系统，以增强透皮递送并评估其结构和功能功效。EV-QuerCar采用嗜热细菌脂质通过超速离心、薄膜水化和高压均质仿生制备。体外测试了其理化性质、透皮渗透、细胞摄取和细胞毒性。分子对接和qPCR评估了通路靶向。EV-QuerCar表现出均匀的尺寸（94.70 ± 0.71 nm）、高包封率（90.07%）、持续释放，以及相比游离化合物3.21倍的透皮吸收增强。成纤维细胞中的细胞摄取随时间增加（4小时时高达5.48倍）。分子对接和qPCR确认了与NRF2和HES1靶点的相互作用，在紫外线暴露的人成纤维细胞中显著上调其mRNA水平（分别为2.29倍和3.35倍）。EV-QuerCar改善了皮肤渗透性和抗氧化功效，凸显了其化妆品应用前景。
